'''2020 TMW Pods Adam Trunzo DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Adam Trunzo]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Adam Trunzo]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open HD Trunzo DS 2020 TMW.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Pods
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-texas-mini-worlds/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20201027000438/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-texas-mini-worlds/ Internet Archive]
